reasoning.title: Open the repository commit history

reasoning.content: Inspect every commit under the exact displayed date heading, load or paginate until that date’s complete group and its boundary are visible, and count each qualifying author row individually. Verify full author identity and exact spelling—open the commit detail if the list abbreviates it—and report only a count supported by visibly inspected matching rows, not an inference or guess.

Review all pagination or loaded history needed to cover that date, distinguish near-identical author names, and answer only after the complete set of qualifying rows is visibly verified.

Because adjacent icon-only counts can represent different metrics, open the project detail page when necessary to verify the labeled star value; copy the full namespace and repository name, and include every qualifying or tied row while enforcing strict threshold wording exactly.

reasoning.title: Open and bound the commit history
